project.name: 真宝鼎以北15公里至阳朔平乐交界DEM拼接任务
project.lineagePolicy: 保留每张源DEM、下载记录、哈希、覆盖计数与填补标记，不将12.5米输出像元表述为原生12.5米测绘高程。

runtimeSource.productLabel: AWS Terrain Tiles约30米临时完整范围DEM
runtimeSource.provider: AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles, Mapzen Skadi
runtimeSource.dataset: Global bare-earth terrain tiles assembled from open elevation sources
runtimeSource.replacementPolicy: EARTHDATA_TOKEN可用后由ASF RTC_HI_RES参考DEM整体替换
runtimeSource.attribution: Terrain Tiles on AWS, Mapzen and upstream source attributions

terrain.noDataPolicy: 网页只显示已下载的真实DEM像元；禁止插值外推补边

fineRegions.name: 真寶鼎
fineRegions.accuracyPolicy: 12.5m verified source pixels; no upsampling and not a native 1m survey
fineRegions.displayGridPolicy: 12.5m source pixels; browser may resample focus view to 2,400×2,400 for smoother display
fineRegions.waterwayPolicy: focus remaps the filtered global water-surface polygons; reservoirs and dams excluded
fineRegions.sourceCoveragePolicy: mosaic-first; fill only NoData cells from verified 12.5m source GeoTIFF tiles when the mosaic extent is insufficient

terrain.waterwayLabelPolicy: 只绘制水面，不显示水系名称

ecology.renderPolicy: 近景聚焦至 200 平方公里时显示生态实例；现有生态样本覆盖仍为 10 平方公里，不扩展为全图测绘植被数据
ecology.detailPolicy: 树冠、灌丛与稻田行纹使用共享地面采样贴地渲染；仅作视觉示意

terrain.waterwayControlPolicy: browser-only visual width, visibility, and color controls; source geometry remains unchanged
